ecosystem_completion_slices.purpose: Expand RFC-0108 into a governed ecosystem observability contract and per-app gap matrix before runtime work resumes.
Make uniform observability the platform default through scaffolding and CI enforcement.

Implement backend freshness, data-quality, and supportability signals in participating services; lotus-core portfolio readiness supportability, lotus-risk risk/calculate/drawdown/rolling/historical-attribution/concentration supportability, lotus-performance TWR/MWR/contribution/attribution supportability, lotus-advise advisory supportability, lotus-manage action-register supportability, lotus-report evidence-surface supportability, lotus-render render supportability, lotus-archive archive supportability, and lotus-ai AI surface supportability are implemented. Gateway PR #166 now reconciles performance/risk source supportability through the experience API; Workbench PR #118 reconciles Gateway source_supportability arrays into supported Workbench freshness/supportability derivation and validation summaries.

Complete Gateway fan-out metrics and protected diagnostics for selected Workbench performance and risk analytics fan-out, central manage/report/archive/AI client seams, and direct lotus-core query/control-plane plus ingestion client seams.

Roll observability out to supported Workbench reads; supported Portfolio workspace, client-side Performance, Risk, and explicit report-batch operator reads are instrumented through a code-owned observed-surface registry reconciled to the governed endpoint registry, with canonical browser proof, source support-state proof, and partial RFC-0079 performance evidence-context reconciliation captured while full RFC-0079 risk/evidence scope and backend freshness reconciliation stay planned.
Extend dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and operator diagnostics across every currently implemented RFC-0108 metric family without sensitive dashboard variables, annotations, or alert labels.
Prove the complete supported Lotus user journey end to end across the current implemented RFC-0108 scope while preserving backend freshness and full RFC-0079 residuals as planned.
Perform ecosystem hardening, API certification, and no-open-P0/P1 review.
Close RFC-0108 for the current implementation-backed ecosystem observability scope while preserving unsupported backend freshness and full Workbench promotion residuals as planned.
